### Filming

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: Filming")]

[Principal photography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principal_photography "Principal photography") began on June 7, 2021, in [Los Angeles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles "Los Angeles").[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Production-54) Filming also took place in parts of [Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peru "Peru") such as [Machu Picchu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machu_Picchu "Machu Picchu"), [Cusco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cusco "Cusco"), [Tarapoto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tarapoto "Tarapoto"), and [San Martín](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Department_of_San_Mart%C3%ADn "Department of San Martín"),[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Vary-38)[Montreal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Montreal "Montreal"),[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-55)[New Mexico](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Mexico "New Mexico"), [Iceland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iceland "Iceland"),[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-56) and [Brooklyn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brooklyn "Brooklyn").[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-57) On October 20, it was announced that filming had officially wrapped.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-58)

## Music

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=11 "Edit section: Music")]

Main article: [Transformers: Rise of the Beasts (soundtrack)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts_(soundtrack) "Transformers: Rise of the Beasts (soundtrack)")

[Jongnic Bontemps](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jongnic_Bontemps "Jongnic Bontemps") provided the film's score, after previously working with Caple on his directorial debut, _[The Land](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Land\_(2016\_film) "The Land (2016 film)")_. Bontemps is the third composer in the series after [Steve Jablonsky](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Jablonsky "Steve Jablonsky") and [Dario Marianelli](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dario_Marianelli "Dario Marianelli").[[61]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-61) Recording sessions for the score began on March 27, 2023, at the Eastwood Scoring Stage at [Warner Bros.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Warner_Bros. "Warner Bros.")[[62]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-62) Jablonsky would later be involved in the film's score.[[63]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-63) The score references tracks written by Jablonsky for _[Transformers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers\_(film) "Transformers (film)")_ (2007), namely "Arrival to Earth" and "No Sacrifice, No Victory", as well as [Vince DiCola](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vince_DiCola "Vince DiCola")'s "Unicron Medley" from _[The Transformers: The Movie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Transformers:\_The\_Movie "The Transformers: The Movie")_ (1986).[[64]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-64)

To keep the authenticity of the film's setting, Caple confirmed tracks from the rap groups [Wu-Tang Clan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wu-Tang_Clan "Wu-Tang Clan") and [A Tribe Called Quest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_Tribe_Called_Quest "A Tribe Called Quest") would be featured.[[65]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-65)

On May 18, 2023, the song "On My Soul", composed by [Tobe Nwigwe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tobe_Nwigwe "Tobe Nwigwe") and [Nas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nas "Nas") and featuring [Jacob Banks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jacob_Banks "Jacob Banks"), was released as a single from the film's soundtrack.[[66]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-66)

On June 7, 2024, a new score album was released for the film's anniversary, featuring eight new tracks with Bontemps' ideas and rough sketches for the original album.[[67]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-67)

## Marketing

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=12 "Edit section: Marketing")]

Paramount showed a [sizzle reel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sizzle_reel "Sizzle reel") of the film at their [CinemaCon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Association_of_Theatre_Owners "National Association of Theatre Owners") presentation in April 2022.[[68]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-68)

A [teaser trailer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teaser_trailer "Teaser trailer") was released on December 1, 2022.[[69]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-69) In an interview with [BET](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BET "BET"), Caple discussed his decision to handpick the trailer's song, a remix of "[Juicy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juicy_(The_Notorious_B.I.G._song) "Juicy (The Notorious B.I.G. song)")" by [The Notorious B.I.G.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Notorious_B.I.G. "The Notorious B.I.G.") He explained it as the "perfect" choice since Notorious B.I.G.'s album "[Ready to Die](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ready_to_Die "Ready to Die")" was released in the 1990s, the time period the film is set in. He further said that Notorious B.I.G.'s "voice and what he meant in that era and time" captured much of what they were doing in the film.[[70]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-70) The trailer garnered 238 million views on [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube") in its first 24 hours, more than any previous trailer in Paramount's history, and was in fourth place for that 24-hour cycle behind two _[Avengers: Endgame](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avengers:\_Endgame "Avengers: Endgame")_ (2019) trailers and the first _[Spider-Man: No Way Home](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spider-Man:\_No\_Way\_Home "Spider-Man: No Way Home")_ (2021) trailer. In addition, the trailer also achieved 494 million global, cross-platform views in the first week, more than the view count of other film trailers released that week, such as those for _[Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indiana\_Jones\_and\_the\_Dial\_of\_Destiny "Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny")_, _[The Super Mario Bros. Movie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Super\_Mario\_Bros.\_Movie "The Super Mario Bros. Movie")_, and _[Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guardians\_of\_the\_Galaxy\_Vol.\_3 "Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3")_.[[71]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-71)

A 30-second [Porsche](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porsche "Porsche") advertisement as a [TV spot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TV_spot "TV spot") aired during [Super Bowl LVII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super_Bowl_LVII "Super Bowl LVII") on February 12, 2023.[[72]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-72) Optimus Prime was featured at the [Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Kids'_Choice_Awards "2023 Kids' Choice Awards") on March 4, 2023, for the Lifetime Achievement Award.[[73]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-73) Over a month later, Prime would then appear at [Coachella 2023](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella_2023 "Coachella 2023"), presenting Tobe Nwigwe, one of the film's stars.[[74]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-74)

The [trailer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trailer_(promotion) "Trailer (promotion)") was released on April 27, 2023.[[75]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-75) It uses "[Ruff Ryders' Anthem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ruff_Ryders'_Anthem "Ruff Ryders' Anthem")" by [DMX](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DMX "DMX"). Many commentators highlighted the appearance of Scourge and Unicron as the main villains for the film, though some highlighted that the DMX song used was not released until 1998, four years after the film is set.[[76]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-76)[[77]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-77)

### Theatrical

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=14 "Edit section: Theatrical")]

_Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ had its world premiere at [Marina Bay Sands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marina_Bay_Sands "Marina Bay Sands") in Singapore on May 27, 2023,[[78]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-78)[[79]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-79) and was released theatrically in the United States on June 9, 2023[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-:1-80) in [IMAX](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IMAX "IMAX"),[[81]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-81)[Dolby Cinema](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dolby_Cinema "Dolby Cinema"),[[82]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-82)[4DX](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/4DX "4DX"),[[83]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-83) and [RealD 3D](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RealD_3D "RealD 3D") formats.[[84]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-84) The film was delayed from its initial release date of June 24, 2022.[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-:1-80) Internationally, the film was released on dates ranging from June 6, 2023 (in South Korea), to June 22, 2023, the film's Australian release date. The film was released in Japan on August 4, 2023.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-NUM-6)

### Home media

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=15 "Edit section: Home media")]

_Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ was released on [Digital HD](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_distribution "Digital distribution") on July 11, 2023, and was released on [4K Ultra HD Blu-ray](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ultra_HD_Blu-ray "Ultra HD Blu-ray"), [Blu-ray](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blu-ray "Blu-ray") and [DVD](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DVD-Video "DVD-Video") on October 10, 2023.[[85]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-85) The film grossed $11.2 million in home sales.[[86]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-86)

## Reception

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=16 "Edit section: Reception")]

### Box office

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=17 "Edit section: Box office")]

_Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ grossed $157.3 million in the United States and Canada, and $284.3 million in other territories, for a worldwide gross of $441.7 million.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-BOM-5)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-NUM-6) It underperformed at the box office and became the lowest-grossing installment of the franchise.[[87]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-makeover-87)[[88]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Childress-88)[[89]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Williams-89)

In the United States and Canada, _Rise of the Beasts_ was projected to gross $50–60 million from 3,673 theaters in its opening weekend.[[90]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-90)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-DeadlineProj-3) The film made $25.6 million on its first day, including $8.8 million from Wednesday and Thursday night preview screenings, up from the totals of _The Last Knight_ ($5.5 million in 2017) and _Bumblebee_ ($2.85 million in 2018). It went on to debut to $60.5 million, topping the box office.[[91]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-opening-91) In its second weekend the film dropped 67% to $20 million, finishing fourth.[[92]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-92) It then made $11.6 million in its third weekend.[[93]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-93)

The film broke records in Peru, earning $6,165,943 in its opening week,[[94]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-94) and as of August 10, 2023, it is the highest-grossing film in Peru of all time, surpassing _[Avengers: Endgame](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avengers:\_Endgame "Avengers: Endgame")_, with earnings of over 52.6 million [soles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peruvian_sol "Peruvian sol") while also bringing in 3.7 million viewers. Peru was the fourth highest-grossing territory for the film, behind only the United States, China and Mexico.[[95]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-95)[[96]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-96)

### Critical response

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=18 "Edit section: Critical response")]

On the [review aggregator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Review_aggregator "Review aggregator") website [Rotten Tomatoes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotten_Tomatoes "Rotten Tomatoes"), 51% of 237 critics' reviews are positive, with an average rating of 5.2/10.The website's consensus reads: "Thanks to some genuine human drama between the set pieces and palpable affection for the title characters, _Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ is one of the franchise's more enjoyable outings."[[97]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Rotten_Tomatoes-97)[Metacritic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metacritic "Metacritic"), which uses a [weighted average](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weighted_arithmetic_mean "Weighted arithmetic mean"), assigned the film a score of 42 out of 100, based on 51 critics, indicating "mixed or average" reviews.[[98]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Metacritic-98) Audiences polled by [CinemaScore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CinemaScore "CinemaScore") gave the film an average grade of "A–" on an A+ to F scale, while those polled at [PostTrak](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PostTrak "PostTrak") gave it an 83% overall positive score, with 68% saying they would "definitely recommend" it.[[91]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-opening-91)

Matt Donato of _[IGN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IGN "IGN")_ gave the film a 7 out of 10, stating that "_Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ proves that _Bumblebee_ wasn't a fluke, and that the _Transformers_ series is finally accelerating in the right direction."[[99]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-IGNReview-99)[Christy Lemire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christy_Lemire "Christy Lemire") of _[RogerEbert.com](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RogerEbert.com "RogerEbert.com")_, gave the film 2.5 out of 4 stars, and called it "better than most offerings in the franchise" but was critical of the lack of stakes, and emphasis on the set pieces over the human characters.[[100]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-100) Graeme Guttmann of _[Screen Rant](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screen\_Rant "Screen Rant")_ awarded the film a score of two and a half stars out of five, saying "There are a few bright spots in Rise of the Beasts, but these are largely overshadowed by a lot of generic parts that would not be out of place in any of the previous six Transformers movies."[[101]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-101)

Chris Vognar of _[Rolling Stones](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling\_Stones "Rolling Stones")_ said, "_Beasts_ encourages you to let your eyes glaze over through the plot exposition and embrace the visceral nonsense. _Beasts_ is dumber than a box of hammers, but it doesn't drip with the rote cynicism of, say, _[Fast X](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fast\_X "Fast X")_."[[102]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-102)[Robbie Collin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robbie_Collin "Robbie Collin") of _[The Daily Telegraph](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Daily\_Telegraph "The Daily Telegraph")_ gave the film a 1 out of 5 rating and said, "Quake, ye mortals, before the [Toys R Us](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toys_%22R%22_Us "Toys \"R\" Us") Cinematic Universe: accessories sold separately; batteries, entertainment and point not included."[[103]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-103)[Richard Roeper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Roeper "Richard Roeper") of the _[Chicago Sun-Times](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago\_Sun-Times "Chicago Sun-Times")_ gave the film two out of four stars, writing "Never fear, though, the old-school adventure soon gives way to yet another fast-cut, murky, CGI-fueled action sequence. The stakes couldn't be lower, the excitement any less palpable. How many times have we already seen these too-long battle scenes in which computer-created machines and/or creatures bang into each other and tear each other apart while proclaiming it all ends today or some such thing?"[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-104) During the opening monologue for the [96th Academy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/96th_Academy_Awards "96th Academy Awards") in 2024, host [Jimmy Kimmel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Kimmel "Jimmy Kimmel") referenced the film's questionable state as a joke about if it was written by [Artificial intelligence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence "Artificial intelligence").[[105]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-105)

### Accolades

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=19 "Edit section: Accolades")]

_Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ was nominated for Best Summer 2023 Blockbuster Trailer at the 2023 [Golden Trailer Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Trailer_Awards "Golden Trailer Awards").[[106]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-106)[[107]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-107) It received a nomination for [Outstanding Visual Effects – Feature Film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HPA_Award_for_Outstanding_Visual_Effects_%E2%80%93_Feature_Film "HPA Award for Outstanding Visual Effects – Feature Film") at the 2023 [Hollywood Professional Association Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollywood_Professional_Association_Awards "Hollywood Professional Association Awards").[[108]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-108) Bontemps was nominated for [Best Original Score — Sci-Fi/Fantasy Film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollywood_Music_in_Media_Award_for_Best_Original_Score_in_a_Sci-Fi/Fantasy_Film "Hollywood Music in Media Award for Best Original Score in a Sci-Fi/Fantasy Film") at the [14th Hollywood Music in Media Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/14th_Hollywood_Music_in_Media_Awards "14th Hollywood Music in Media Awards").[[109]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-109) The film was also nominated for [Best Science Fiction Film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saturn_Award_for_Best_Science_Fiction_Film "Saturn Award for Best Science Fiction Film") at the [Saturn Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saturn_Awards "Saturn Awards") but lost to _[Avatar: The Way of Water](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar:\_The\_Way\_of\_Water "Avatar: The Way of Water")_.[[110]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-110)

## Future

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=20 "Edit section: Future")]

In February 2022, Paramount announced that _Rise of the Beasts_ would be the first of three new installments in the _Transformers_ series.[[111]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-111)[[112]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-112) In May 2023, it was also announced Paramount was also planning a [crossover](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crossover_(fiction) "Crossover (fiction)") between the _Transformers_ and _[G.I. Joe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/G.I.\_Joe\_(film\_series) "G.I. Joe (film series)")_ franchises.[[113]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-113) The ending of _Rise of the Beasts_ hints at this being a possible future, with Noah being asked to join G.I. Joe.[[114]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-VultureGIJoe-114) In July 2023, di Bonaventura stated that while the crossover would not interfere with the continuity of the franchise's first five installments, he believed that "continuity’s overblown, because sometimes you miss a great idea."[[115]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-115) The crossover was later officially announced at [CinemaCon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CinemaCon "CinemaCon") 2024.[[116]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-116) With [Derek Connolly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Derek_Connolly "Derek Connolly") attached as screenwriter in June of that year.[[117]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-117) In July 2025 Ramos noted the film's uncertain status due to the [Skydance-Paramount merger](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Merger_of_Skydance_Media_and_Paramount_Global "Merger of Skydance Media and Paramount Global").[[118]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-118) The following year in April 2026, Caple Jr. confirmed that the crossover is still in development and expresses hopes to be involved in some capacity.[[119]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-119)

On November 20, 2024, after the underperformance of the animated film _[Transformers One](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers\_One "Transformers One")_ (2024), Hasbro announced that they would no longer be co-financing film adaptations of their products, instead leaving external studios to exclusively fund such projects.[[120]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-120) In June 2025, it was reported that Bay was in talks to return as both a producer and director for a new film based on a screenplay written by Jordan VanDina.[[121]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-121)[[122]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-122)

_**Transformers: Rise of the Beasts**_ is a 2023 American [science fiction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science_fiction_film "Science fiction film")[action film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Action_film "Action film") based on [Hasbro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hasbro "Hasbro")'s _[Transformers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers\_(toy\_line) "Transformers (toy line)")_ franchise. It is the seventh installment in the [_Transformers_ film series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers_(film_series) "Transformers (film series)"), and a sequel to _[Bumblebee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bumblebee\_(film) "Bumblebee (film)")_ (2018).[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Davids-05-10-7) The film was directed by [Steven Caple Jr.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steven_Caple_Jr. "Steven Caple Jr.") and written by [Joby Harold](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joby_Harold "Joby Harold"), Darnell Metayer, Josh Peters, Erich Hoeber, and Jon Hoeber, and stars [Anthony Ramos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anthony_Ramos "Anthony Ramos") and [Dominique Fishback](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dominique_Fishback "Dominique Fishback"), alongside the voices of [Ron Perlman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ron_Perlman "Ron Perlman"), [Peter Dinklage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Dinklage "Peter Dinklage"), [Michelle Yeoh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michelle_Yeoh "Michelle Yeoh"), [Pete Davidson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pete_Davidson "Pete Davidson"), [Liza Koshy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liza_Koshy "Liza Koshy"), [Michaela Jaé Rodriguez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michaela_Ja%C3%A9_Rodriguez "Michaela Jaé Rodriguez"), [Colman Domingo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colman_Domingo "Colman Domingo"), [Cristo Fernández](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cristo_Fern%C3%A1ndez "Cristo Fernández"), [Tongayi Chirisa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tongayi_Chirisa "Tongayi Chirisa"), and returning franchise regulars [Peter Cullen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Cullen "Peter Cullen"), [John DiMaggio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_DiMaggio "John DiMaggio"), and [David Sobolov](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Sobolov "David Sobolov"). Set in 1994, the film follows ex-military electronics expert Noah Diaz and artifact researcher Elena Wallace as they help the [Autobots](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Autobots "List of Transformers film series cast and characters") and the [Maximals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Maximals "List of Transformers film series cast and characters") protect an artifact known as the Transwarp Key from the villainous [Terrorcons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Terrorcons "List of Transformers film series cast and characters").

A sequel was being fast-tracked by the studio after the critical and commercial success of _Bumblebee_ after being announced in January 2019. Two additional films were in development the following year with one of them being based on the _[Beast Wars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Beast\_Wars "Transformers: Beast Wars")_ series in 2020. Caple Jr. was hired as director that November later that year. The film was officially announced months later in 2021 during a virtual presentation as both a _Bumblebee_ sequel and a _Beast Wars_ film in one. [Principal photography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principal_photography "Principal photography") took place from June to October 2021, with filming locations including Los Angeles, [Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peru "Peru"), Montreal, and New York City.

_Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ premiered at [Marina Bay Sands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marina_Bay_Sands "Marina Bay Sands") in Singapore on May 27, 2023, and was theatrically released in the United States on June 9, 2023, by [Paramount Pictures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paramount_Pictures "Paramount Pictures"). The film received mixed reviews from critics with many deeming it as inferior to the preceding _Bumblebee_ film. It grossed a total of $441.7 million worldwide against a budget of $195–200 million, becoming a [box-office disappointment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box-office_disappointment "Box-office disappointment"). This was the last _Transformers_ film to feature Cullen as the voice of [Optimus Prime](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Optimus_Prime "Optimus Prime") before his death in 2026.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-8)

## Plot

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Plot")]

The planet-eating [Transformer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers "Transformers"), [Unicron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unicron#Film_series "Unicron"), attacks the homeworld of the [Maximals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Maximals "List of Transformers film series cast and characters"). Unicron sends his herald, [Scourge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Scourge "List of Transformers film series cast and characters"), and the [Terrorcons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Terrorcons "List of Transformers film series cast and characters") to obtain the Transwarp Key, which can open portals through time and space, allowing Unicron to consume planets faster. The Maximal leader Apelinq sacrifices himself to allow the other Maximals to escape the planet before Unicron devours it. The Maximals' new leader, [Optimus Primal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Optimus_Primal "List of Transformers film series cast and characters"), escapes to [Earth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Earth "Earth") with the key.

In 1994 [Brooklyn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brooklyn "Brooklyn"), Noah Diaz, an ex-[military](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Armed_Forces "United States Armed Forces") electronics expert, struggles to find a job to support his ill brother Kris and is convinced by his friend Reek to steal a [Porsche](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porsche_964 "Porsche 964") to sell, only to discover that it is the [Autobot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Autobots "List of Transformers film series cast and characters")[Mirage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Dino/Mirage "List of Transformers film series cast and characters") in disguise. Concurrently, museum intern Elena Wallace studies an ancient statue of a falcon bearing the Maximal symbol and accidentally breaks it open to reveal the key hidden inside. The key releases an energy pulse detected by Autobot leader [Optimus Prime](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Optimus_Prime#Transformers_(film_series) "Optimus Prime"), who summons the other Autobots, including [Arcee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arcee#Transformers_Cinematic_Universe "Arcee") and [Bumblebee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bumblebee_(Transformers)#Transformers_(film_series) "Bumblebee (Transformers)"). Mirage is contacted in the middle of Noah's attempted theft, and he is roped into the Autobots' mission to recover the key so they can use it to return to their homeworld, Cybertron.

Drawn by the key's signature, the Terrorcons arrive on Earth and attack the Autobots outside the museum, with Elena caught up in the conflict. Scourge kills Bumblebee, steals the key, and the Terrorcons retreat when the Maximal [Airazor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Airazor "List of Transformers film series cast and characters") arrives to repel them. Airazor reveals that the Maximals have been hiding on Earth, and Scourge only has half of the Transwarp Key, which was split in two to keep it safe. Prime insists that the key be reassembled so the Autobots can use it to return home, while Noah secretly plots to destroy the key to keep Earth safe.

Elena deduces that the other half of the key is in a hidden temple in [Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peru "Peru"). The cargo plane Autobot Stratosphere takes them to Peru, where they meet with [Wheeljack](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#Que/Wheeljack "List of Transformers film series cast and characters"), who leads them to the temple. However, the other half of the key is revealed to be no longer there. The Terrorcons attack again, and Scourge corrupts Airazor with Dark Energon. Subsequently, the Autobots meet Primal and the Maximals, who entrusted the second half of the key to a human tribe they have worked with for millennia. Scourge's corruption overtakes Airazor, whom Primal reluctantly kills at her request to save Elena. In the chaos, Noah attempts to destroy the second half of the key, but Prime convinces him otherwise. Scourge steals it and then reassembles the two halves, erecting a tower and opening a portal above Earth for Unicron to enter.

Prime and Noah agree to work together to protect their homeworlds from Unicron. While the Autobots and Maximals battle the Terrorcon army, Noah and Elena sneak in close to the Key, planning to deactivate it with an access code Elena has uncovered. During the battle, Mirage is wounded by Scourge while protecting Noah but transforms his damaged body into a powered [exo-suit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Powered_exoskeleton "Powered exoskeleton") for Noah so they can fight together. Bumblebee is reactivated when the key activates the Energon-infused valley, and helps the Autobots and Maximals turn the tide of the battle. Prime kills Scourge, but not before the latter damages the control console to prevent the portal from being shut down. Prime destroys the key and collapses the portal, willing to sacrifice himself, but Noah and Primal save him from being sucked into the imploding [vortex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vortex "Vortex"), which destroys the remaining Terrorcon army and leaves Unicron stranded.

In the aftermath, the Autobots, unable to return to Cybertron, proclaim Earth as their new home and vow to continue protecting it alongside the Maximals. Elena receives recognition for discovering the temple in Peru while Noah attends an interview for a security job but finds he is actually being invited to join the secret military organization [G.I. Joe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/G.I._Joe_Team "G.I. Joe Team"), who will cover Kris's healthcare. Some time later, Noah repairs Mirage using junk Porsche parts from Reek, who claims it is not road-worthy; Noah disproves him by calling Mirage to transform in front of Reek.

## Production

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: Production")]

### Development

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Development")]

In December 2018, when asked about the future of the _[Transformers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers\_(film\_series) "Transformers (film series)")_ franchise, producer [Lorenzo di Bonaventura](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lorenzo_di_Bonaventura "Lorenzo di Bonaventura") stated that another big _Transformers_ film "would be produced" and that it would be "different than the ones that we've done before." He described the process as more of an "evolution," saying that there is more freedom to create and what they can do with it. After the success of _[Bumblebee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bumblebee\_(film) "Bumblebee (film)")_ that year, he said that the series would make some changes in tone and style, inspired by the film.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-29)_Bumblebee_ director [Travis Knight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Travis_Knight "Travis Knight") said his goal was to return to his animation studio, [Laika](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laika_(company) "Laika (company)"), though he acknowledged that he has a few ideas for a sequel.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-30)[John Cena](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Cena "John Cena") expressed interest in reprising his role in a sequel.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-31) Writer [Christina Hodson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christina_Hodson "Christina Hodson") said that "[she] knows where [she wants] to go with the next one".[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-variety-hodson-32) In late January 2019, a sequel was announced.[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-33) In March, di Bonaventura confirmed they were developing a script for a _Bumblebee_ sequel.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-cbr.com-34)

In January 2020, [Paramount Pictures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paramount_Pictures "Paramount Pictures") was reportedly working on two different _Transformers_ films, one written by [James Vanderbilt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Vanderbilt "James Vanderbilt") and another written by [Joby Harold](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joby_Harold "Joby Harold").[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-35) In November, [Steven Caple Jr.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steven_Caple_Jr. "Steven Caple Jr.") was hired to direct Harold's script.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-36) In February 2021, it was revealed that the film was going under the working title _Transformers: Beast Alliance_, hinting the introduction of characters from the _[Beast Wars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Beast\_Wars "Transformers: Beast Wars")_ franchise.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-BeastAlliance-37) During a virtual event held by Paramount in June, di Bonaventura and Caple revealed the official title as _Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ (revealing to be both a _Bumblebee_ sequel and _Beast Wars_ film in one),[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Vary-38) and confirming that it would feature the [Maximals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maximals "Maximals"), the Predacons, and a new take on the [Terrorcons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Terrorcons "Terrorcons") faction.[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Grobar2-39) The film's tone and action were heavily influenced by _[Terminator 2: Judgment Day](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Terminator\_2:\_Judgment\_Day "Terminator 2: Judgment Day")_ (1991).[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-40) Despite the announcement of the Predacons, no such member appeared in the finished film.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-41)

In an April 2023 interview, Di Bonaventura stated that the film's story will have a character arc for Optimus Prime prior to the [2007 film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers_(film) "Transformers (film)"), akin to Bumblebee in his self-titled film.[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-42) In May, Caple said that the events of the 2007 film will be preserved, but also that the story would be standalone and that "Ultimately, all you need to know is that they're trying to get back to Cybertron."[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Davids-05-10-7)Michael Bay again serves as producer, along with the same producers as the previous film. [Duncan Henderson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duncan_Henderson "Duncan Henderson") joined as producer, in what would be his final film before his death from pancreatic cancer.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Kilkenny-43)

In April 2021, [Anthony Ramos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anthony_Ramos "Anthony Ramos") was cast for the lead role in the film.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-44) Later that month, [Dominique Fishback](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dominique_Fishback "Dominique Fishback") was cast opposite Ramos.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Kroll-45) It was also revealed that Darnell Metayer and Josh Peters had been hired to rewrite Harold's screenplay.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Kroll-45) Ultimately, Harold, Metayer, Peters, along with Erich and Jon Hoeber received screenplay credit, with Harold solely receiving story credit, while [Ken Nolan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ken_Nolan "Ken Nolan"), Tony Rettenmaier, [Juel Taylor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juel_Taylor "Juel Taylor"), and Vanderbilt received "additional literary material" credit off-screen.[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-46)

In June, actress [Lauren Vélez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lauren_V%C3%A9lez "Lauren Vélez") revealed that she has a role in the sequel.[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-47) In the same month, [Peter Cullen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Cullen "Peter Cullen") was confirmed to return as [Optimus Prime](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Optimus_Prime "Optimus Prime") for the film,[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Vary-38) and [Ron Perlman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ron_Perlman "Ron Perlman") was announced to be reprising his role as Optimus Primal from the _[Power of the Primes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power\_of\_the\_Primes "Power of the Primes")_ web series a week later.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Collider-19) In July, rapper [Tobe Nwigwe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tobe_Nwigwe "Tobe Nwigwe") revealed that he had a role in the film, making his film debut.[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Preview-48) In October 2022, Caple Jr. revealed that [Michelle Yeoh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michelle_Yeoh "Michelle Yeoh") and [Pete Davidson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pete_Davidson "Pete Davidson") will voice Airazor and Mirage, respectively, in the film.[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-auto1-22)

_[Revenge of the Fallen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Revenge\_of\_the\_Fallen "Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen")_, [Cristo Fernández](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cristo_Fern%C3%A1ndez "Cristo Fernández") as Wheeljack and voice actors [John DiMaggio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_DiMaggio "John DiMaggio") and [David Sobolov](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Sobolov "David Sobolov") from previous installments in dual roles for each actor.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Deadline12-01-11) DiMaggio voices Stratosphere, an Autobot that originated from the toyline of _Revenge of the Fallen_ and the _[Dark of the Moon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Dark\_of\_the\_Moon "Transformers: Dark of the Moon")_[video game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Dark_of_the_Moon_(video_game) "Transformers: Dark of the Moon (video game)") from 2009 to 2011, and Transit, a Decepticon that turns into a [transit ### Filming

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: Filming")]

[Principal photography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principal_photography "Principal photography") began on June 7, 2021, in [Los Angeles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles "Los Angeles").[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Production-54) Filming also took place in parts of [Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peru "Peru") such as [Machu Picchu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machu_Picchu "Machu Picchu"), [Cusco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cusco "Cusco"), [Tarapoto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tarapoto "Tarapoto"), and [San Martín](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Department_of_San_Mart%C3%ADn "Department of San Martín"),[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Vary-38)[Montreal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Montreal "Montreal"),[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-55)[New Mexico](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Mexico "New Mexico"), [Iceland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iceland "Iceland"),[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-56) and [Brooklyn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brooklyn "Brooklyn").[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-57) On October 20, it was announced that filming had officially wrapped.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-58)

### Post-production

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=10 "Edit section: Post-production")]

Rather than [Industrial Light and Magic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Industrial_Light_and_Magic "Industrial Light and Magic") from the previous installments, the film's visual effects for the _Transformers_ and _Beast Wars_ characters were provided by [Moving Picture Company](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moving_Picture_Company "Moving Picture Company") and [Wētā FX](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/W%C4%93t%C4%81_FX "Wētā FX").[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-59)[[60]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-60)

## Music

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=11 "Edit section: Music")]

Main article: [Transformers: Rise of the Beasts (soundtrack)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts_(soundtrack) "Transformers: Rise of the Beasts (soundtrack)")

[Jongnic Bontemps](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jongnic_Bontemps "Jongnic Bontemps") provided the film's score, after previously working with Caple on his directorial debut, _[The Land](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Land\_(2016\_film) "The Land (2016 film)")_. Bontemps is the third composer in the series after [Steve Jablonsky](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Jablonsky "Steve Jablonsky") and [Dario Marianelli](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dario_Marianelli "Dario Marianelli").[[61]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-61) Recording sessions for the score began on March 27, 2023, at the Eastwood Scoring Stage at [Warner Bros.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Warner_Bros. "Warner Bros.")[[62]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-62) Jablonsky would later be involved in the film's score.[[63]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-63) The score references tracks written by Jablonsky for _[Transformers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers\_(film) "Transformers (film)")_ (2007), namely "Arrival to Earth" and "No Sacrifice, No Victory", as well as [Vince DiCola](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vince_DiCola "Vince DiCola")'s "Unicron Medley" from _[The Transformers: The Movie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Transformers:\_The\_Movie "The Transformers: The Movie")_ (1986).[[64]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-64)

To keep the authenticity of the film's setting, Caple confirmed tracks from the rap groups [Wu-Tang Clan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wu-Tang_Clan "Wu-Tang Clan") and [A Tribe Called Quest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_Tribe_Called_Quest "A Tribe Called Quest") would be featured.[[65]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-65)

On May 18, 2023, the song "On My Soul", composed by [Tobe Nwigwe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tobe_Nwigwe "Tobe Nwigwe") and [Nas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nas "Nas") and featuring [Jacob Banks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jacob_Banks "Jacob Banks"), was released as a single from the film's soundtrack.[[66]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-66)

On June 7, 2024, a new score album was released for the film's anniversary, featuring eight new tracks with Bontemps' ideas and rough sketches for the original album.[[67]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-67)

## Marketing

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=12 "Edit section: Marketing")]

Paramount showed a [sizzle reel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sizzle_reel "Sizzle reel") of the film at their [CinemaCon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Association_of_Theatre_Owners "National Association of Theatre Owners") presentation in April 2022.[[68]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-68)

A [teaser trailer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teaser_trailer "Teaser trailer") was released on December 1, 2022.[[69]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-69) In an interview with [BET](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BET "BET"), Caple discussed his decision to handpick the trailer's song, a remix of "[Juicy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juicy_(The_Notorious_B.I.G._song) "Juicy (The Notorious B.I.G. song)")" by [The Notorious B.I.G.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Notorious_B.I.G. "The Notorious B.I.G.") He explained it as the "perfect" choice since Notorious B.I.G.'s album "[Ready to Die](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ready_to_Die "Ready to Die")" was released in the 1990s, the time period the film is set in. He further said that Notorious B.I.G.'s "voice and what he meant in that era and time" captured much of what they were doing in the film.[[70]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-70) The trailer garnered 238 million views on [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube") in its first 24 hours, more than any previous trailer in Paramount's history, and was in fourth place for that 24-hour cycle behind two _[Avengers: Endgame](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avengers:\_Endgame "Avengers: Endgame")_ (2019) trailers and the first _[Spider-Man: No Way Home](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spider-Man:\_No\_Way\_Home "Spider-Man: No Way Home")_ (2021) trailer. In addition, the trailer also achieved 494 million global, cross-platform views in the first week, more than the view count of other film trailers released that week, such as those for _[Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indiana\_Jones\_and\_the\_Dial\_of\_Destiny "Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny")_, _[The Super Mario Bros. Movie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Super\_Mario\_Bros.\_Movie "The Super Mario Bros. Movie")_, and _[Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guardians\_of\_the\_Galaxy\_Vol.\_3 "Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3")_.[[71]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-71)

A 30-second [Porsche](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porsche "Porsche") advertisement as a [TV spot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TV_spot "TV spot") aired during [Super Bowl LVII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super_Bowl_LVII "Super Bowl LVII") on February 12, 2023.[[72]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-72) Optimus Prime was featured at the [Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Kids'_Choice_Awards "2023 Kids' Choice Awards") on March 4, 2023, for the Lifetime Achievement Award.[[73]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-73) Over a month later, Prime would then appear at [Coachella 2023](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella_2023 "Coachella 2023"), presenting Tobe Nwigwe, one of the film's stars.[[74]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-74)

The [trailer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trailer_(promotion) "Trailer (promotion)") was released on April 27, 2023.[[75]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-75) It uses "[Ruff Ryders' Anthem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ruff_Ryders'_Anthem "Ruff Ryders' Anthem")" by [DMX](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DMX "DMX"). Many commentators highlighted the appearance of Scourge and Unicron as the main villains for the film, though some highlighted that the DMX song used was not released until 1998, four years after the film is set.[[76]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-76)[[77]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-77)

## Release

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=13 "Edit section: Release")]

### Theatrical

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=14 "Edit section: Theatrical")]

## Reception

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=16 "Edit section: Reception")]

### Box office

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=17 "Edit section: Box office")]

_Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ grossed $157.3 million in the United States and Canada, and $284.3 million in other territories, for a worldwide gross of $441.7 million.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-BOM-5)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-NUM-6) It underperformed at the box office and became the lowest-grossing installment of the franchise.[[87]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-makeover-87)[[88]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Childress-88)[[89]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Williams-89)

In the United States and Canada, _Rise of the Beasts_ was projected to gross $50–60 million from 3,673 theaters in its opening weekend.[[90]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-90)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-DeadlineProj-3) The film made $25.6 million on its first day, including $8.8 million from Wednesday and Thursday night preview screenings, up from the totals of _The Last Knight_ ($5.5 million in 2017) and _Bumblebee_ ($2.85 million in 2018). It went on to debut to $60.5 million, topping the box office.[[91]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-opening-91) In its second weekend the film dropped 67% to $20 million, finishing fourth.[[92]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-92) It then made $11.6 million in its third weekend.[[93]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-93)

The film broke records in Peru, earning $6,165,943 in its opening week,[[94]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-94) and as of August 10, 2023, it is the highest-grossing film in Peru of all time, surpassing _[Avengers: Endgame](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avengers:\_Endgame "Avengers: Endgame")_, with earnings of over 52.6 million [soles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peruvian_sol "Peruvian sol") while also bringing in 3.7 million viewers. Peru was the fourth highest-grossing territory for the film, behind only the United States, China and Mexico.[[95]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-95)[[96]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-96)

### Critical response

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=18 "Edit section: Critical response")]

On the [review aggregator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Review_aggregator "Review aggregator") website [Rotten Tomatoes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotten_Tomatoes "Rotten Tomatoes"), 51% of 237 critics' reviews are positive, with an average rating of 5.2/10.The website's consensus reads: "Thanks to some genuine human drama between the set pieces and palpable affection for the title characters, _Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ is one of the franchise's more enjoyable outings."[[97]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Rotten_Tomatoes-97)[Metacritic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metacritic "Metacritic"), which uses a [weighted average](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weighted_arithmetic_mean "Weighted arithmetic mean"), assigned the film a score of 42 out of 100, based on 51 critics, indicating "mixed or average" reviews.[[98]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-Metacritic-98) Audiences polled by [CinemaScore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CinemaScore "CinemaScore") gave the film an average grade of "A–" on an A+ to F scale, while those polled at [PostTrak](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PostTrak "PostTrak") gave it an 83% overall positive score, with 68% saying they would "definitely recommend" it.[[91]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-opening-91)

Matt Donato of _[IGN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IGN "IGN")_ gave the film a 7 out of 10, stating that "_Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ proves that _Bumblebee_ wasn't a fluke, and that the _Transformers_ series is finally accelerating in the right direction."[[99]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-IGNReview-99)[Christy Lemire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christy_Lemire "Christy Lemire") of _[RogerEbert.com](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RogerEbert.com "RogerEbert.com")_, gave the film 2.5 out of 4 stars, and called it "better than most offerings in the franchise" but was critical of the lack of stakes, and emphasis on the set pieces over the human characters.[[100]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-100) Graeme Guttmann of _[Screen Rant](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screen\_Rant "Screen Rant")_ awarded the film a score of two and a half stars out of five, saying "There are a few bright spots in Rise of the Beasts, but these are largely overshadowed by a lot of generic parts that would not be out of place in any of the previous six Transformers movies."[[101]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-101)

Chris Vognar of _[Rolling Stones](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling\_Stones "Rolling Stones")_ said, "_Beasts_ encourages you to let your eyes glaze over through the plot exposition and embrace the visceral nonsense. _Beasts_ is dumber than a box of hammers, but it doesn't drip with the rote cynicism of, say, _[Fast X](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fast\_X "Fast X")_."[[102]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-102)[Robbie Collin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robbie_Collin "Robbie Collin") of _[The Daily Telegraph](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Daily\_Telegraph "The Daily Telegraph")_ gave the film a 1 out of 5 rating and said, "Quake, ye mortals, before the [Toys R Us](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toys_%22R%22_Us "Toys \"R\" Us") Cinematic Universe: accessories sold separately; batteries, entertainment and point not included."[[103]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-103)[Richard Roeper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Roeper "Richard Roeper") of the _[Chicago Sun-Times](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago\_Sun-Times "Chicago Sun-Times")_ gave the film two out of four stars, writing "Never fear, though, the old-school adventure soon gives way to yet another fast-cut, murky, CGI-fueled action sequence. The stakes couldn't be lower, the excitement any less palpable. How many times have we already seen these too-long battle scenes in which computer-created machines and/or creatures bang into each other and tear each other apart while proclaiming it all ends today or some such thing?"[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-104) During the opening monologue for the [96th Academy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/96th_Academy_Awards "96th Academy Awards") in 2024, host [Jimmy Kimmel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Kimmel "Jimmy Kimmel") referenced the film's questionable state as a joke about if it was written by [Artificial intelligence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence "Artificial intelligence").[[105]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-105)

### Accolades

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=19 "Edit section: Accolades")]

_Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_ was nominated for Best Summer 2023 Blockbuster Trailer at the 2023 [Golden Trailer Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Trailer_Awards "Golden Trailer Awards").[[106]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-106)[[107]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-107) It received a nomination for [Outstanding Visual Effects – Feature Film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HPA_Award_for_Outstanding_Visual_Effects_%E2%80%93_Feature_Film "HPA Award for Outstanding Visual Effects – Feature Film") at the 2023 [Hollywood Professional Association Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollywood_Professional_Association_Awards "Hollywood Professional Association Awards").[[108]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-108) Bontemps was nominated for [Best Original Score — Sci-Fi/Fantasy Film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollywood_Music_in_Media_Award_for_Best_Original_Score_in_a_Sci-Fi/Fantasy_Film "Hollywood Music in Media Award for Best Original Score in a Sci-Fi/Fantasy Film") at the [14th Hollywood Music in Media Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/14th_Hollywood_Music_in_Media_Awards "14th Hollywood Music in Media Awards").[[109]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-109) The film was also nominated for [Best Science Fiction Film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saturn_Award_for_Best_Science_Fiction_Film "Saturn Award for Best Science Fiction Film") at the [Saturn Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saturn_Awards "Saturn Awards") but lost to _[Avatar: The Way of Water](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar:\_The\_Way\_of\_Water "Avatar: The Way of Water")_.[[110]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-110)

## Future

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts&action=edit&section=20 "Edit section: Future")]

In February 2022, Paramount announced that _Rise of the Beasts_ would be the first of three new installments in the _Transformers_ series.[[111]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-111)[[112]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-112) In May 2023, it was also announced Paramount was also planning a [crossover](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crossover_(fiction) "Crossover (fiction)") between the _Transformers_ and _[G.I. Joe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/G.I.\_Joe\_(film\_series) "G.I. Joe (film series)")_ franchises.[[113]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-113) The ending of _Rise of the Beasts_ hints at this being a possible future, with Noah being asked to join G.I. Joe.[[114]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-VultureGIJoe-114) In July 2023, di Bonaventura stated that while the crossover would not interfere with the continuity of the franchise's first five installments, he believed that "continuity’s overblown, because sometimes you miss a great idea."[[115]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-115) The crossover was later officially announced at [CinemaCon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CinemaCon "CinemaCon") 2024.[[116]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-116) With [Derek Connolly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Derek_Connolly "Derek Connolly") attached as screenwriter in June of that year.[[117]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-117) In July 2025 Ramos noted the film's uncertain status due to the [Skydance-Paramount merger](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Merger_of_Skydance_Media_and_Paramount_Global "Merger of Skydance Media and Paramount Global").[[118]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-118) The following year in April 2026, Caple Jr. confirmed that the crossover is still in development and expresses hopes to be involved in some capacity.[[119]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-119)

On November 20, 2024, after the underperformance of the animated film _[Transformers One](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers\_One "Transformers One")_ (2024), Hasbro announced that they would no longer be co-financing film adaptations of their products, instead leaving external studios to exclusively fund such projects.[[120]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-120) In June 2025, it was reported that Bay was in talks to return as both a producer and director for a new film based on a screenplay written by Jordan VanDina.[[121]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-121)[[122]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Rise_of_the_Beasts#cite_note-122)

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

List of films directed and produced by Michael Bay

[![Image 4: A photograph of Michael Bay on the set of Transformers](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ec/Michael.bay.png/250px-Michael.bay.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Michael.bay.png)

Bay on the set of his film _[Transformers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers\_(film) "Transformers (film)")_ in 2006

Michael Bay, an American director and producer, started his career directing music videos and commercials. This included a commercial for the [American Red Cross](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Red_Cross "American Red Cross") in 1992 which received a Clio Award, and music videos for [Donny Osmond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donny_Osmond "Donny Osmond"), [Styx](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Styx_(band) "Styx (band)") and [Meat Loaf](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meat_Loaf "Meat Loaf"). [Jerry Bruckheimer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerry_Bruckheimer "Jerry Bruckheimer") recognizing his achievements on commercials offered the chance to direct one of his productions as Bay's feature film debut.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-1) Bay did so with Bruckheimer's [action comedy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Action_comedy_film "Action comedy film")_[Bad Boys](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bad\_Boys\_(1995\_film) "Bad Boys (1995 film)")_ starring [Will Smith](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Will_Smith "Will Smith"), and [Martin Lawrence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Martin_Lawrence "Martin Lawrence"). In the same year he also received a [Directors Guild of America Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Directors_Guild_of_America_Award "Directors Guild of America Award") for his work on commercials.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-2) Bay followed this with [action film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Action_film "Action film")_[The Rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Rock\_(film) "The Rock (film)")_ starring [Sean Connery](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sean_Connery "Sean Connery"), and [Nicolas Cage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicolas_Cage "Nicolas Cage"). The film was a commercial success grossing over $335 million at the worldwide box office.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-3) In 1998, he directed, and produced the [science fiction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science_fiction "Science fiction") disaster film _[Armageddon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Armageddon\_(1998\_film) "Armageddon (1998 film)")_ which was the highest-grossing film of the year,[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-4) and Bay received the [Saturn Award for Best Director](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saturn_Award_for_Best_Director "Saturn Award for Best Director").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-5) After the success of _Armageddon_ he also became the youngest director to gross $1 billion at the worldwide box office.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-6)[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-7)

Three years later he directed and produced the war film _[Pearl Harbor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pearl\_Harbor\_(film) "Pearl Harbor (film)")_ (2001) which was negatively received by critics[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-8) but grossed over $449 million at the box office.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-9) Later in the same year, Bay founded his own production company [Platinum Dunes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Platinum_Dunes "Platinum Dunes") with [Brad Fuller](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bradley_Fuller "Bradley Fuller"), and [Andrew Form](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andrew_Form "Andrew Form").[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-10) In 2003, Bay directed the action comedy sequel _[Bad Boys II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bad\_Boys\_II "Bad Boys II")_ which saw Smith and Lawrence reprise their roles.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-11) Two years later he directed science fiction action film _[The Island](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Island\_(2005\_film) "The Island (2005 film)")_ (2005), and produced the horror remake _[The Amityville Horror](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Amityville\_Horror\_(2005\_film) "The Amityville Horror (2005 film)")_ (2005).[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-12)

In 2007, Bay directed, and produced the first film in [the live-action _Transformers_ film series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers_(film_series) "Transformers (film series)") based on the [toy line of the same name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers_(toy_line) "Transformers (toy line)"). It was a commercial success grossing over $709 million at the box office.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-13) He followed this by directing its sequel _[Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Revenge\_of\_the\_Fallen "Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen")_ (2009). The film drew negative reception from critics[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-14) but grossed over $836 million at the box office.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-15) The third installment in the series _[Transformers: Dark of the Moon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Dark\_of\_the\_Moon "Transformers: Dark of the Moon")_ (2011) became the first of his films to gross over $1 billion at the box office.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-16) Two years later Bay directed and produced crime comedy _[Pain & Gain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pain\_&\_Gain "Pain & Gain")_ (2013). From 2014 to 2017, he executive produced the television series _[Black Sails](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black\_Sails\_(TV\_series) "Black Sails (TV series)")_ for [Starz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starz "Starz"). In 2014, he directed, and produced a fourth Transformer film, _[Transformers: Age of Extinction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Age\_of\_Extinction "Transformers: Age of Extinction")_, which grossed over $1 billion at the box office, and was the highest-grossing film at the worldwide box office that year.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-17) Three years later, he directed the fifth entry in the _Transformers_ film series, _[Transformers: The Last Knight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_The\_Last\_Knight "Transformers: The Last Knight")_ which received generally negative reviews from critics and was the lowest-grossing live-action film worldwide in the franchise's history until _Transformers: Rise of the Beasts_.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-18)[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay_filmography#cite_note-19)
