## Release

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen&action=edit&section=14 "Edit section: Release")]

### Theatrical

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen&action=edit&section=15 "Edit section: Theatrical")]

_Revenge of the Fallen_ premiered on June 8, 2009, in Tokyo, Japan.[[101]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-105) After its UK release on June 19, it was released in regular and [IMAX](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IMAX "IMAX") theaters in North America on June 24,[[102]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-106) although some theaters held limited-access advance screenings on June 22. [Linkin Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linkin_Park "Linkin Park") held a special show after the premiere at the [Fox Theater, Westwood Village](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fox_Theater,_Westwood_Village "Fox Theater, Westwood Village") on June 22, during which they performed "[New Divide](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Divide "New Divide")" live for the first time. The IMAX release featured additional scenes of extended robot fighting sequences, which were not seen in the regular theater version.[[103]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-107)

### Home media

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen&action=edit&section=16 "Edit section: Home media")]

The film was released in two-disc [Blu-ray](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blu-ray "Blu-ray") and [DVD](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DVD "DVD") editions, and a single-disc DVD version on October 20, 2009, in North America.[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-108) Michael Bay has revealed that the Blu-ray release of the film, produced by [Charles de Lauzirika](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_de_Lauzirika "Charles de Lauzirika"), features variable aspect ratio for the scenes shot in [IMAX format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IMAX#Technical_specifications "IMAX"). A special "Big Screen" IMAX edition was available exclusively at [Walmart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Walmart "Walmart").[[105]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-109) Home versions include over three hours of bonus content and several interactive features, including "The AllSpark Experiment", which reveals Michael Bay's plans for a third movie in the series. At [Target](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Target_Corporation "Target Corporation"), the DVD and Blu-ray versions include a transformable Bumblebee case. Both two-disc editions are the first to include Paramount's [augmented reality](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Augmented_reality "Augmented reality") feature, which allows the user to handle a 3-D model of Optimus Prime on a computer by moving the package in front of a webcam.[[106]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-110) First-week sales of the DVD reached 7.5 million copies, making it the best-selling DVD of 2009. The Blu-ray version had the best first-week sales of 2009, with 1.2 million units.[[107]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-111)_Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen_ was released on 4K UHD Blu-ray on December 5, 2017.[[108]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-112) The film grossed $276 million in home sales.[[109]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-113)

## Reception

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen&action=edit&section=17 "Edit section: Reception")]

### Box office

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen&action=edit&section=18 "Edit section: Box office")]

_Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen_ earned $16 million from Tuesday midnight previews, setting a record for the biggest Wednesday midnight debut at the time.[[110]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-114) It held the record for the biggest preview grosses for a [Paramount](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paramount_Pictures "Paramount Pictures") film until _[Top Gun: Maverick](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Top\_Gun:\_Maverick "Top Gun: Maverick")_ surpassed it in 2022 with $19.3 million.[[111]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-115) On its opening day, the film grossed $62 million, surpassing _[Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harry\_Potter\_and\_the\_Order\_of\_the\_Phoenix\_(film) "Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix (film)")_ ($44.2 million) for the biggest Wednesday opening in history.[[112]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-116) It also ranked as the second-biggest opening day ever at the time, behind _[The Dark Knight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Dark\_Knight "The Dark Knight")_.[[113]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-117) The record for biggest Wednesday opening was broken the following year by _[The Twilight Saga: Eclipse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Twilight\_Saga:\_Eclipse "The Twilight Saga: Eclipse")_, which earned $68.5 million.[[114]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-118)_Revenge of the Fallen_ grossed $109 million during its opening weekend, the seventh-largest opening weekend at the time. Its Friday-to-Sunday gross also set a new record for the biggest June opening weekend, surpassing _[Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harry\_Potter\_and\_the\_Prisoner\_of\_Azkaban\_(film) "Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (film)")_ ($93.7 million), before being overtaken by _[Toy Story 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toy\_Story\_3 "Toy Story 3")_ the following year.[[115]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-119) The film earned $200 million during its first five days, the second-largest five-day opening at the time behind _The Dark Knight_ ($203.7 million).[[116]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-120) It retained the record for the biggest five-day Wednesday opening until _[The Super Mario Bros. Movie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Super\_Mario\_Bros.\_Movie "The Super Mario Bros. Movie")_ earned $204.6 million in 2023.[[117]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-121)

_Revenge of the Fallen_ remained at number one at the box office for two consecutive weekends. Although initial studio estimates projected a tie with _[Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ice\_Age:\_Dawn\_of\_the\_Dinosaurs "Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs")_, final figures showed _Revenge of the Fallen_ retaining the top position with $42.3 million.[[118]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-122) It was overtaken in its third weekend by _[Brüno](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Br%C3%BCno "Brüno")_ and the second weekend of _Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs_. The film became the first release of 2009 to surpass $300 million at the North American box office.[[119]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-123) On July 27, one month after its release, it reached $379.2 million domestically, placing it among the ten highest-grossing films of all time in the United States and Canada at the time.[[120]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-124)

The film closed from theaters on October 15, 2009, after grossing $402.1 million in the United States and Canada and $434.2 million in other territories, bringing its worldwide total to $836.5 million.[[121]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-:0-125) It was the second-highest-grossing film of 2009 in the United States and Canada behind _[Avatar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar\_(2009\_film) "Avatar (2009 film)")_,[[122]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-126) and the fourth-highest-grossing film worldwide behind _Avatar_, _[Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harry\_Potter\_and\_the\_Half-Blood\_Prince\_(film) "Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince (film)")_, and _[Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ice\_Age:\_Dawn\_of\_the\_Dinosaurs "Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs")_.[[123]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-127) At the end of its theatrical run, it ranked as the 37th-highest-grossing film in the United States and Canada.[[121]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-:0-125)[Box Office Mojo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box_Office_Mojo "Box Office Mojo") estimates that the film sold over 53 million tickets domestically.[[121]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-:0-125)

### Critical response

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen&action=edit&section=19 "Edit section: Critical response")]

On [Rotten Tomatoes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotten_Tomatoes "Rotten Tomatoes"), the film has an approval rating of 19% based on 248 reviews, with an average rating of 4.1/10. The site's critical consensus reads, "_Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen_ is a noisy, underplotted, and overlong special effects extravaganza that lacks a human touch."[[124]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-rt-128) On [Metacritic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metacritic "Metacritic"), the film has an average score of 35 out of 100, based on 32 critics, indicating "generally unfavorable reviews".[[125]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-129) Audiences polled by [CinemaScore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CinemaScore "CinemaScore") gave the film an average grade of "B+" on an A+ to F scale.[[126]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-130)

According to _[The Washington Post](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Washington\_Post "The Washington Post")_, _Revenge of the Fallen_ was Bay's worst-reviewed film at the time of release, faring even worse than _[Pearl Harbor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pearl\_Harbor\_(film) "Pearl Harbor (film)")_ (2001).[[127]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-washingtonpost-critics-131) Betsy Sharkey of the _[Los Angeles Times](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los\_Angeles\_Times "Los Angeles Times")_ described the film as "in-your-face, ear-splitting and unrelenting. It's easy to walk away feeling like you've spent 2 hours in the mad, wild, hydraulic embrace of a [car compactor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Car_crusher "Car crusher")".[[128]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-132)

[Roger Ebert](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roger_Ebert "Roger Ebert"), who had given the 2007 film three stars,[[129]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-133) gave the sequel only one, calling it "...a horrible experience of unbearable length", a phrase which later became the title of his third bad-movie-reviews collection. Later in his review, Ebert discouraged movie-goers from seeing the film by saying "If you want to save yourself the ticket price, go into the kitchen, cue up a male choir singing the music of hell, and get a kid to start banging pots and pans together. Then close your eyes and use your imagination."[[130]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-134) He later wrote on his blog about the film, "The day will come when _Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen_ will be studied in film classes and shown at cult film festivals. It will be seen, in retrospect, as marking the end of an era. Of course there will be many more CGI-based action epics, but never again one this bloated, excessive, incomprehensible, long (149 minutes) or expensive ($200 million)."[[131]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-135) Ebert would continue to lambast the film (and, sometimes, the _Transformers_ franchise in general) in other movie reviews and responses to letters and emails sent to him.[[132]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-136)[[133]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-137)_[Rolling Stone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling\_Stone "Rolling Stone")_ critic [Peter Travers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Travers "Peter Travers") called it "beyond bad, it carves out its own category of godawfulness" and did not give the film any stars, considering that "_Revenge of the Fallen_ has a shot at the title 'Worst Movie of the Decade'."[[134]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-Rolling_Stone_Review-138) Travers named it the worst of 2009 and later the "worst film of the decade".[[135]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-139)[[136]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-140)[[137]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-141)

Some reviews were less harsh, with the film's CGI effects receiving praise. _[The A.V. Club](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_A.V.\_Club "The A.V. Club")_ gave the film a "C−", complaining about the writing and length, but mentioning the effects and action scenes were impressive.[[138]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-142) Among positive reviews, Amy Biancolli of the _[Houston Chronicle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Houston\_Chronicle "Houston Chronicle")_ called it "a well-oiled, loudly revving summer action vehicle that does all that's required, and then some",[[139]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-143) Jordan Mintzer from _[Variety](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variety\_(magazine) "Variety (magazine)")_ said it "takes the franchise to a vastly superior level of artificial intelligence",[[140]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-144) and [Owen Gleiberman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Owen_Gleiberman "Owen Gleiberman") of _[Entertainment Weekly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Entertainment\_Weekly "Entertainment Weekly")_ wrote that "_Revenge of the Fallen_ may be a massive overdose of popcorn greased with motor oil. But it knows how to feed your inner 10-year-old's appetite for destruction."[[141]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-145) A review from _[Empire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Empire\_(magazine) "Empire (magazine)")_ said: "What saves it, just about, are the effects. At times the frame is so packed with whirring cogs and twirling cranks that you could replicate the effect by staring at the innards of a domestic appliance, but when these CGI moto-men from another world duke it out, the images are often so screwy it's impossible to do anything but sit and stare."[[142]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-146)

There was considerable negative reaction to the characters Mudflap and Skids, who some perceived as embodying racist [stereotypes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stereotype "Stereotype"). Manohla Dargis of _[The New York Times](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_New\_York\_Times "The New York Times")_ said that "the characters [...] indicate that [minstrelsy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minstrel_show "Minstrel show") remains as much in fashion in Hollywood as when, well, [Jar Jar Binks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jar_Jar_Binks "Jar Jar Binks") was set loose by [George Lucas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Lucas "George Lucas")".[[143]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-147) Critic Scott Mendelson said "To say that these two are the most astonishingly racist caricatures that I've ever seen in a mainstream motion picture would be an understatement."[[144]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-148)[Harry Knowles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harry_Knowles "Harry Knowles"), founder of [Ain't It Cool News](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ain't_It_Cool_News "Ain't It Cool News"), went further, asking his readers "not to support this film" because "you'll be taking [your children] to see a film with the lowest forms of humor, stereotypes, and racism around."[[145]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-149) Bay (the director) has attempted to defend the film as "good clean fun" and insisted that "We're just putting more personality in."[[146]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Revenge_of_the_Fallen#cite_note-150) Writers Roberto Orci and Alex Kurtzman responded to the controversy with "It's really hard for us to sit here and try to justify it. ## Autobots

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Autobots")]

The **Autobots** are the main protagonists of the _Transformers_ film series who come from the planet Cybertron.

### Optimus Prime

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Optimus Prime")]

See also: [Optimus Prime §Transformers film series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Optimus_Prime#Transformers_film_series "Optimus Prime")

**[Optimus Prime](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Optimus_Prime#Transformers_(film_series) "Optimus Prime")** (voiced by [Peter Cullen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Cullen "Peter Cullen")) is the main [protagonist](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protagonist "Protagonist") of the _Transformers_ film series, the brave and valiant leader of the Autobots, the last descendant of the Dynasty of Primes and keeper of the [Matrix of Leadership](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matrix_of_Leadership "Matrix of Leadership"). Optimus Prime transforms into a 1994 red and blue [Peterbilt 379](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peterbilt_379 "Peterbilt 379")[semi-trailer truck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-trailer_truck "Semi-trailer truck") in the first three films, a rusty 1973 [Marmon HDT-AC 86](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marmon_Motor_Company "Marmon Motor Company") semi cab-over truck in the beginning of the fourth film, and later a blue and red 2014 [Western Star 5700XE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Western_Star_Trucks "Western Star Trucks") Phantom semi-truck.

In the [first film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers_(film) "Transformers (film)"), Optimus Prime arrives on Earth with Ratchet, Ironhide, and Jazz trying to find the AllSpark. At Mission City, he kills Bonecrusher and battles Megatron, but Sam pushes the AllSpark into Megatron's chest, killing him and destroying the cube; as a result, Cybertron can no longer be restored. Afterward, Optimus and the other Autobots form an alliance with the humans and work closely with them, with the resulting alliance being called NEST.

In _[Revenge of the Fallen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Revenge\_of\_the\_Fallen "Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen")_, Optimus is killed by Megatron during a battle with him, Starscream, and Grindor. Near the end of the film, he is revived by Sam with the Matrix of Leadership and is fused with Jetfire, making him more powerful. Optimus Prime then faces the Fallen and Megatron. After a vicious fight, Optimus severely wounds Megatron and kills the Fallen, telling him to "give me your face."

In _[Dark of the Moon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Dark\_of\_the\_Moon "Transformers: Dark of the Moon")_, Optimus revives Sentinel Prime using the Matrix of Leadership and reveals he was the leader of the Autobots before him. However, Sentinel betrays the Autobots and joins the Decepticons to restore Cybertron with the Pillars; meanwhile, the Autobots are sent into space. During the battle in Chicago, Optimus kills some Decepticons, including the Driller, Shockwave, and Megatron before he kills Sentinel Prime. In the film, Optimus is depicted with a trailer similar to his Generation 1 counterpart,[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-1) and has been redesigned to look more heroic.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-ILMMakeover-2) The trailer contains enhanced weapons and flight gear. Optimus loses his right arm to Sentinel Prime at the film's climax.

In _[Age of Extinction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Age\_of\_Extinction "Transformers: Age of Extinction")_, he is hunted by Harold Attinger, Cemetery Wind, and Lockdown, who is working for the Creators to bring him to Cybertron and kill any Autobots who refuse to give up his location. A badly wounded Optimus is discovered by struggling inventor Cade Yeager, who shelters him. Escaping the eyes of Cemetery Wind, Optimus leads the Autobots once again, taming the Dinobots and rides Grimlock to fight Galvatron and his new army of man-made Transformers. After defeating Galvatron's army, he kills Attinger and Lockdown. He sets the Dinobots free and asks his fellow Autobots to protect Cade and his family before taking the Seed into space and going after the Creators. At the start of the movie, Optimus uses a mode similar to his G1 counterpart but with a lot of rust.

In _[The Last Knight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_The\_Last\_Knight "Transformers: The Last Knight")_, Optimus arrives at Cybertron, now a dead planet. He finds Quintessa, the Prime of Life, who brainwashes Optimus to do her bidding of destroying the Earth, which she reveals is an ancient enemy planet, [Unicron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unicron "Unicron"). She tells Prime that he must retrieve her staff to rebuild Cybertron. Prime's eyes turn purple and becomes Nemesis Prime under Quintessa's control. Just as he is about to kill Bumblebee, Bee speaks for the first time in ten years, which causes him to return to normal. He rides Dragonstorm into battle. After defeating Quintessa and saving both worlds, Optimus and the Autobots return to Cybertron, which has joined with the Earth into one planet.

Optimus Prime reappears and appears similar to his G1 counterpart in _[Bumblebee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bumblebee\_(film) "Bumblebee (film)")_. He leads the Autobots against the Decepticons trying to take over Cybertron, but is forced to retreat when Decepticon reinforcements led by Soundwave and Shockwave attack them. Realizing that Cybertron has fallen, he orders all Autobots to get to their escape pods. He gives Bumblebee the task to protect the Earth and set up a base for them before being attacked by Ravage and other Decepticons.

In _[Transformers: Rise of the Beasts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Rise\_of\_the\_Beasts "Transformers: Rise of the Beasts")_, Optimus Prime reappears and appears similar to his G1 counterpart; he transforms into a [Freightliner FLA-8664T](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freightliner_Trucks "Freightliner Trucks")[semi-trailer truck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-trailer_truck "Semi-trailer truck"), a form which he gained previously in _Bumblebee_. Optimus and his fellow Autobots had been hiding for the past seven years, waiting for a means to return to Cybertron. When the signal of a Transwarp Key is activated in Brooklyn, he rallies the other Autobots to investigate the signal, with Mirage bringing in a civilian named Noah Diaz. Despite Bumblebee's earlier encounter with a human, Optimus is distrustful of human help. Optimus comes face-to-face with the Terrorcons' leader, Scourge, who defeats him in combat. Optimus witnesses the deactivation of Bumblebee, making it his mission to avenge his fallen comrade. Bumblebee, who would be revived by an infusion of raw Energon, would be avenged as Optimus disarms Scourge and rips out his head, destroying the Transwarp Key to stop [Unicron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unicron "Unicron")'s advance.

### Bumblebee

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Bumblebee")]

See also: [Bumblebee (Transformers) §Transformers (film series)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bumblebee_(Transformers)#Transformers_(film_series) "Bumblebee (Transformers)")

**[Bumblebee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bumblebee_(Transformers)#Transformers_(film_series) "Bumblebee (Transformers)")** (voiced by [Mark Ryan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_Ryan_(actor) "Mark Ryan (actor)") in the 2007 film and the second video game, [Fred Tatasciore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fred_Tatasciore "Fred Tatasciore") in the third video game, [Ben Schwartz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ben_Schwartz "Ben Schwartz") in _Age of Extinction_,[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-3)[Erik Aadahl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Erik_Aadahl "Erik Aadahl") in _The Last Knight_, [Dylan O'Brien](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dylan_O'Brien "Dylan O'Brien") in _Bumblebee_) is a loyal, courageous, and fun-loving Autobot [scout](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reconnaissance "Reconnaissance"), Hot Rod's brother-in-arms, and Sam's former guardian in the first three films, and later becomes Optimus' second-in-command in the following two. Due to his voicebox being damaged during the battle for Cybertron, he's hardly able to speak, only able to communicate through radio recordings and recorded movie and song quotes. Bumblebee transforms into various types of [Chevrolet Camaros](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Camaro "Chevrolet Camaro"); the first four films depict him as fifth generation Camaros before switching to a sixth generation in _The Last Knight_. _Bumblebee_ depicts him as a Volkswagen Beetle, and _Rise of the Beasts_ depicts him as a second-generation Camaro.

In _Transformers_, Sam Witwicky purchases a dirty [1977 Chevrolet Camaro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Camaro_(second_generation) "Chevrolet Camaro (second generation)"), but it reveals it's actually an Autobot, Bumblebee. Later Bumblebee turns into a 2007 Chevrolet Camaro. Bumblebee is wounded during the battle at Mission City, though is able to defeat Brawl with Mikaela's help. Throughout the movie, Bumblebee uses radio soundbites to communicate due to his vocal box being damaged in battle; the prequel movie _Bumblebee_ attributes this damage to the hands of Blitzwing. However, Bumblebee regains his voice by the end of the movie.

In _Revenge of the Fallen_, Bumblebee once again uses radio soundbites to communicate due to the bugs of his voice, and Sam tells Mikaela that Bumblebee is "playing it up". Bumblebee is sad about Sam's departure from college, though they would be reunited after a brief skirmish with a Pretender named Alice. Later in Egypt, Bumblebee faces off against both Rampage and Ravage, who he defeats.

In _Dark of the Moon_, Bumblebee, now separated from Sam, assists NEST in the Autobots' mission to prevent human conflict. After Sentinel's betrayal, Bumblebee and his fellow Autobots were sent into space. Bumblebee would land the finishing blow on the control pillar, destroying it.

For _Age of Extinction_, Bumblebee is a modified vintage [1967 Chevrolet Camaro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Camaro_(first_generation) "Chevrolet Camaro (first generation)"), and later a [2014 Chevrolet Camaro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Camaro_(fifth_generation) "Chevrolet Camaro (fifth generation)") concept. He appears after Optimus calls all the Autobots and has a rivalry with Drift. He later aids Hound in a battle, kills Stinger, and rides Strafe.

In _The Last Knight_, Bumblebee transforms into a [2016 Chevrolet Camaro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Camaro_(sixth_generation) "Chevrolet Camaro (sixth generation)") and is accidentally given a female voice akin to [Siri](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siri "Siri"). Near the end, his real voice speaks again to Optimus, turning him back to normal and snapping him out of Quintessa's brainwashing. Flashbacks reveal that he and Hot Rod were the first Autobots to arrive on Earth and fought alongside the [Allied forces](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allies_of_World_War_II "Allies of World War II") to fight the [Nazi Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nazi_Party "Nazi Party") during [World War II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_II "World War II"), and transformed to a 1937 [Mercedes-Benz Typ 320](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_Typ_320 "Mercedes-Benz Typ 320"). He also knows Edmund from when they first met before he met Sam, and has the ability to reassemble himself after being blown to pieces.

Bumblebee is the main protagonist of the [eponymous prequel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bumblebee_(film) "Bumblebee (film)"). He is redesigned to resemble his G1 counterpart but more Bay-inspired and transforms into a 1967 [Volkswagen Beetle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volkswagen_Beetle "Volkswagen Beetle"). In the film, he lands on Earth in 1987 [after Cybertron falls to the Decepticons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Retcon "Retcon"). After his synthetic voice communicator is ripped out and destroyed by Blitzwing, he escapes and befriends Charlie Watson. He comes into conflict with Decepticons Shatter and Dropkick, who are looking for him to learn Optimus Prime's location. After being captured by Sector 7, led by Jack Burns, Shatter and Dropkick interrogate him. Bumblebee manages to kill them, and he and Charlie part ways so he can be with Optimus Prime and the other Autobots.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-4)

Bumblebee reappears in _Rise of the Beasts_, looking similar to his look in [his solo fim](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bumblebee_(film) "Bumblebee (film)") but with a changed head. Bumblebee is deactivated by Scourge before taking the latter's Autobot insignia off as a trophy and stealing the half of Transwarp key. During the final battle, he is revived by the Energon pulsing on Earth, with his arrival turning the tide of the battle.

### Jazz

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: Jazz")]

**[Jazz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jazz_(Transformers)#Transformers_Cinematic_Universe "Jazz (Transformers)")** (voiced by [Darius McCrary](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Darius_McCrary "Darius McCrary") in the first film, [Andrew Kishino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andrew_Kishino "Andrew Kishino") in _Transformers: The Game_, [Troy Baker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Troy_Baker "Troy Baker") in _Rise of the Dark Spark_) is the first lieutenant of the Autobots and Optimus Prime's second-in-command who displays a hip-hop-like personality. Jazz transforms into a modified silver 2006 [Pontiac Solstice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pontiac_Solstice "Pontiac Solstice") Weekend Club Racer concept, making him the smallest of the first film's five Autobots, and is armed with a crescent blaster and an electromagnetic device that he uses to take away the weapons of the Sector Seven agents who took Sam, and Mikaela. In spite of his size, he is a fearless and loyal soldier who is willing to jump into a fight with a larger foe, which leads him to get killed by Megatron during the battle in Mission City.

### Ironhide

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: Ironhide")]

**Ironhide** (voiced by [Jess Harnell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jess_Harnell "Jess Harnell")) is the Autobots' scrappy English-accented weapons specialist who transforms into a modified black 2006 [GMC TopKick](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GMC_TopKick "GMC TopKick") C4500 medium-duty truck. Ironhide is armed with shell cannons. In _Dark of the Moon_, he has a new rifle and a new [rocket launcher](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rocket_launcher "Rocket launcher").

In _Revenge of the Fallen_, Ironhide is the new second-in-command of the autobots after Jazz's death. He is among the Autobots(the others being Optimus Prime, Arcee & her sisters named Elita-1 and Chromia, and Skids & Mudflap) who are sent alongside NEST soldiers to deal with the Decepticons Demolishor(who gets killed by Optimus) and Sideways(who gets killed by Sideswipe) in Shanghai, then later takes over as the Autobots' leader after Optimus is killed by Megatron in the forest. He leads the Autobots in the desert battle and helps Sam get to the pillars where Optimus's body lies. He is heavily damaged and forced to drop his heavy cannons during an airstrike.

In _Dark of the Moon_, he helps Sideswipe take down the Dreads as they chase Sentinel Prime to NEST. Sentinel betrays the Autobots and kills Ironhide with a cosmic rust gun that makes his parts rust & fall off. He also appears in a photo in _Age of Extinction_ and _The Last Knight_. Ironhide also appears in the opening scene of _Bumblebee_.

### Ratchet

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Ratchet")]

**Ratchet** (voiced by [Robert Foxworth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Foxworth "Robert Foxworth") in the first four films and the second video game, Dennis Singletary in _Bumblebee_, [Fred Tatasciore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fred_Tatasciore "Fred Tatasciore") in _Transformers: The Game_ and the third video game, [Keith Szarabajka](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keith_Szarabajka "Keith Szarabajka") in _Rise of the Dark Spark_) is the Autobots' pragmatic [medical officer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Physician "Physician") who transforms into a [Los Angeles Fire Department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles_Fire_Department "Los Angeles Fire Department") Search and Rescue 2004 [Hummer H2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hummer_H2 "Hummer H2"). Ratchet is armed with Energon beam guns and a saw. For _Dark of the Moon_, Ratchet's alt mode has a new green and white paint job. In _Age of Extinction_, he has his spark torn out by Lockdown and his corpse is taken to KSI, who melts his head to build remote-controlled Transformers.

Ratchet reappears in a speaking cameo in _Bumblebee_, looking like his G1 self, where he is among the Autobots seen evacuating Cybertron.

### Sideswipe

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section: Sideswipe")]

**[Sideswipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sideswipe_(Transformers)#Transfomers_Cinematic_Universe "Sideswipe (Transformers)")** (voiced by [André Sogliuzzo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andr%C3%A9_Sogliuzzo "André Sogliuzzo") in _Revenge of the Fallen_, [Nolan North](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nolan_North "Nolan North") in the second video game, [James Remar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Remar "James Remar") in _Dark of the Moon_, [Fred Tatasciore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fred_Tatasciore "Fred Tatasciore") in _Rise of the Dark Spark_) is the Autobots' combat instructor who transforms into a 2009 [Chevrolet Corvette Stingray](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corvette_Stingray_(concept_car) "Corvette Stingray (concept car)") concept. He is argued to be the stand-in for Jazz after his demise in the first film. In _Dark of the Moon_, Sideswipe's vehicle mode is upgraded into a roadster. Sideswipe has blades for hands and uses his feet like roller blades when in combat. His fate in _Age of Extinction_ remains unknown.

### Arcee

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: Arcee")]

**[Arcee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arcee#Transformers_Cinematic_Universe "Arcee")** (voiced by [Liza Koshy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liza_Koshy "Liza Koshy") in _Rise of the Beasts_, [Grey DeLisle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grey_DeLisle "Grey DeLisle") in _Bumblebee_ and _Revenge of the Fallen_) is an Autobot [sharpshooter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sharpshooter "Sharpshooter") who transforms into a red and white [Ducati 848](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ducati_848 "Ducati 848"). Arcee is armed with a machine gun. Her holographic rider in _Revenge of the Fallen_ is portrayed by Erin Naas. She and her sisters are shot by Decepticons.

In _Age of Extinction_, Arcee is listed as deceased by Cemetery Wind.

She reappears in _Bumblebee_ as one of the few Autobots who left Cybertron in escape pods and is a member of the Autobot resistance.

Arcee appears in _Rise of the Beasts,_ where she is one of the few Autobots on Earth. She transforms into a [Ducati 916](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ducati_916 "Ducati 916").

### Mirage(AKA Dino)

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=10 "Edit section: Mirage(AKA Dino)")]

**Mirage(AKA Dino)**[[N 1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-5) (voiced by [Francesco Quinn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Francesco_Quinn "Francesco Quinn") in _Dark of the Moon_ and voiced by [Pete Davidson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pete_Davidson "Pete Davidson") in Rise of the Beasts) is an Autobot spy who has wrist blades and as of the year 2012 transforms into a red 2011 [Ferrari 458 Italia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferrari_458_Italia "Ferrari 458 Italia"), and speaks with an Italian accent. This was Quinn's final role before his death shortly after the film's release. Dino was originally set to die alongside Que, though he ultimately survives. A prop used in filming depicting Dino's head could be spotted in the background in a scene in the final film.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-6)

In _Rise of the Beasts_, he transforms into a 1993 [Porsche 911 (964)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porsche_911 "Porsche 911") Carrera RS 3.8 and possesses the ability to holographically create clones, similar to his G1 counterpart, and displays a fun-loving and groovy attitude. Throughout the events of the film, Mirage forms a close friendship with the human Noah Diaz and his younger brother Kris, promising to protect the two no matter the cost. Mirage, covering fire for Noah and staying true to his promise, is gravely wounded by Scourge but transforms his damaged body into a powered exo-suit for Noah so they can fight together. Noah would manage to repair Mirage, as revealed in the mid-credits scene.

### Que

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=11 "Edit section: Que")]

**Que**[[N 2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-7) (voiced by [George Coe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Coe "George Coe") in _Dark of the Moon_) is an eccentric Autobot military scientist who speaks with an [Irish accent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hiberno-English "Hiberno-English"), whose head design resembles [Albert Einstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albert_Einstein "Albert Einstein") in reference to his genius and he transforms into a blue 2011 [Mercedes-Benz E550](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_E550 "Mercedes-Benz E550"). Wheeljack is an inventor who gives the Autobots weapons and equipment he has created. His name and appearance in _Dark of the Moon_ is similar to the [James Bond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Bond "James Bond") character [Q](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Q_(James_Bond) "Q (James Bond)"). He is killed by Barricade when Soundwave orders his execution before they were killed as well by Bumblebee.

**Wheeljack**

In _Bumblebee_, Wheeljack (voiced by [Steve Blum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Blum "Steve Blum") in _Bumblebee_, [Cristo Fernández](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cristo_Fern%C3%A1ndez "Cristo Fernández") in _Rise of the Beasts)_ is one of the Autobots who escaped Cybertron in an escape pod.

In _Rise of the Beasts_, Wheeljack transforms into a customized brown and white 1970 [Volkswagen Type 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volkswagen_Type_2 "Volkswagen Type 2"), speaks with a [Mexican Spanish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mexican_Spanish "Mexican Spanish") accent, and inexplicably has a completely different appearance.

### Hound

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=12 "Edit section: Hound")]

**Hound** (voiced by [John Goodman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Goodman "John Goodman") in the films, [Daniel Ross](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daniel_Ross_(actor) "Daniel Ross (actor)") in _Transformers: The Game_) is a trigger-happy but loyal and good-natured Autobot [commando](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Commando "Commando")[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-Comicbook.com-8)[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-MichaelBay-9) who transforms into a dark green [Oshkosh Defense](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oshkosh_Corporation "Oshkosh Corporation")[Medium Tactical Truck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Family_of_Medium_Tactical_Vehicles "Family of Medium Tactical Vehicles") in _Age of Extinction_.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-10) Hound is the heavy weapons expert of the small group that carries various types of guns, grenades, and a knife. He is one of the few autobots to survive Lockdown and Cemetery Wind's Earthbound Autobot genocide.

Hound returns in _The Last Knight_, having an olive green [Mercedes-Benz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz "Mercedes-Benz")[Unimog](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unimog "Unimog") military tactical ambulance as his vehicle mode and acting as the medic after Ratchet's death.

### Drift

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=13 "Edit section: Drift")]

**Drift** (voiced by [Ken Watanabe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ken_Watanabe "Ken Watanabe")) is an Autobot tactician, a former Decepticon[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-MichaelBay-9)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-Comicbook.com-8), and a [Triple Changer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triple_Changer "Triple Changer") who transforms into a black and blue 2013 [Bugatti Veyron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bugatti_Veyron "Bugatti Veyron") Grand Sport Vitesse and a [Sikorsky S-97 Raider](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sikorsky_S-97_Raider "Sikorsky S-97 Raider"). He is one of the few Autobots to survive Lockdown and Cemetery Wind's genocide against all Earthbound Cybertronians. His robot is modeled after a [samurai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samurai "Samurai") warrior with a braided beard. Drift is partnered with Dinobot Slug, who he rides into battle at the film's climax. Although mostly calm and collected, Drift tends to resort to violence when something annoys or surprises him. He also has contempt for Bumblebee.

Drift returns in _The Last Knight_ as a black and red 2017 [Mercedes-AMG GT-R](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-AMG_GT "Mercedes-AMG GT"), abandoning his helicopter mode.

### Crosshairs

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=14 "Edit section: Crosshairs")]

**Crosshairs** (voiced by [John DiMaggio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_DiMaggio "John DiMaggio")) is a brash and cocky Autobot [paratrooper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paratrooper "Paratrooper") and [sniper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sniper "Sniper")[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-MichaelBay-9) who transforms into a green 2014 [Chevrolet Corvette Stingray](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Corvette_(C7) "Chevrolet Corvette (C7)") in _Age of Extinction_. He is one of the few Autobots to survive Lockdown and Cemetery Wind's genocide against all Cybertronians. He rides Scorn into battle at the film's climax and later nicknames him Spike after Sam's G1 name. Although he shares the altruistic views as the rest of the Autobots, his ego leaves him to have a misplaced belief that he deserves to be in command of the team.

Crosshairs returns in _The Last Knight_ as a green 2017 Corvette Stingray.

### Hot Rod

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=15 "Edit section: Hot Rod")]

**Hot Rod** (voiced by [Omar Sy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Omar_Sy "Omar Sy")) is an Autobot protector, Bumblebee's brother-in-arms and Viviane's guardian who was first seen as a 1975 [Citroën DS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Citro%C3%ABn_DS "Citroën DS") in disguise, and then transforming into an orange and black 2016 [Lamborghini Centenario](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamborghini_Centenario "Lamborghini Centenario") sports car. Hot Rod speaks with a French accent, much to his own embarrassment. In flashbacks, he and Bumblebee helped fight the Nazis during World War II.

### Wheelie

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=16 "Edit section: Wheelie")]

**Wheelie** (voiced by [Tom Kenny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_Kenny "Tom Kenny")) is a wisecracking Decepticon-spy-turned-Autobot and a partner of Decepticon-turned-Autobot Brains who transforms into a blue [radio-controlled](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Radio_control "Radio control") Ford F-Series [monster truck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monster_truck "Monster truck"), and speaks with a Brooklyn accent.

In _The Last Knight_, Wheelie joins the other Autobots in Cade's junkyard.

### Brains

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=17 "Edit section: Brains")]

**Brains** (voiced by [Reno Wilson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reno_Wilson "Reno Wilson")) is a small and intelligent Decepticon drone turned Autobot and a partner of Wheelie who transforms into a [Lenovo ThinkPad Edge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ThinkPad_Edge "ThinkPad Edge") laptop computer. Brains is armed with a mini-shotgun. In _Dark of the Moon_, Brains loses his right leg after crashing into a river inside a Decepticon ship.

In _Age of Extinction_, Brains reappears, imprisoned by KSI. His fate in _The Last Knight_ is unknown.

### Stratosphere

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=18 "Edit section: Stratosphere")]

**Stratosphere** (voiced by [John DiMaggio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_DiMaggio "John DiMaggio") in the film, [Travis Willingham](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Travis_Willingham "Travis Willingham") in _Rise of the Dark Spark_) is an Autobot Air-Soldier who transforms into a [Fairchild C-119 Flying Boxcar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fairchild_C-119_Flying_Boxcar "Fairchild C-119 Flying Boxcar") cargo plane that provides transportation for the Autobots in their global adventure who debuts in _Rise of the Beasts_. He speaks in a Scottish accent.

### Dinobots

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=19 "Edit section: Dinobots")]

The **Dinobots** are the large Cybertronian Knights who transform into giant mechanical spiked dinosaurs. In _Age of Extinction_, they are captured inside of their ship, which Lockdown took over as his prison ship, until they are freed by Optimus. In _The Last Knight_, only Grimlock and Slug reappear.

#### Grimlock

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=20 "Edit section: Grimlock")]

**[Grimlock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grimlock#Transformers_Cinematic_Universe "Grimlock")** (voiced by [Gregg Berger](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gregg_Berger "Gregg Berger") in _Rise of the Dark Spark_) is the leader of the Dinobots who transforms into a horned mechanical fire-breathing _[Tyrannosaurus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tyrannosaurus "Tyrannosaurus")_, and formerly partnered with Optimus to ride on him.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-ToyImages-11)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-SuperBowl-12)

#### Strafe

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=21 "Edit section: Strafe")]

**Strafe** is one of the Dinobots who specializes in assault infantry and transforms into a mechanical two-headed, two-tailed _[Pteranodon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pteranodon "Pteranodon")_, and formerly partnered with Bumblebee.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-ToyImages-11)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-SuperBowl-12) He is similar to the Dinobot Swoop.

#### Slug

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=22 "Edit section: Slug")]

**Slug** is the savage destroyer amongst the Dinobots who transforms into a mechanical spiked and bestial _[Triceratops](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triceratops "Triceratops")_ and formerly partnered with Drift.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-Screenrant.com-13)

#### Scorn

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=23 "Edit section: Scorn")]

**Scorn** is the Dinobots' demolition specialist who appears in _Age of Extinction_ and transforms into a mechanical three-sailed _[Spinosaurus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spinosaurus "Spinosaurus")_ and formerly partnered with Crosshairs.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-Screenrant.com-13)

### Wreckers

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=24 "Edit section: Wreckers")]

The **Wreckers** are a trio of Autobot [commandoes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Commandoes "Commandoes") and engineers who transform into heavily armed [NASCAR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASCAR "NASCAR")[Sprint Cup Series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASCAR_Sprint_Cup_Series "NASCAR Sprint Cup Series")[Car of Tomorrow](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Car_of_Tomorrow "Car of Tomorrow")[Chevrolet Impala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Impala "Chevrolet Impala") stock cars as disguises. Two represent [Hendrick Motorsports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hendrick_Motorsports "Hendrick Motorsports") and one represents [Earnhardt Ganassi Racing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Earnhardt_Ganassi_Racing "Earnhardt Ganassi Racing"). They also worked on the Autobot ship called _the Xantium_, which the 3 of them and the other Earthbound Autobots who were introduced in _Revenge of The Fallen_ and _Dark of The Moon_(except for Wheelie & Brains and Sentinel Prime) arrived on Earth in.

#### Leadfoot

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=25 "Edit section: Leadfoot")]

**Leadfoot** (voiced by John DiMaggio) is the Wreckers' leader who transforms into an armored version of the No. 42 [Earnhardt Ganassi Racing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Earnhardt_Ganassi_Racing "Earnhardt Ganassi Racing")[Target](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Target_Corporation "Target Corporation") car driven at the time by [Juan Pablo Montoya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juan_Pablo_Montoya "Juan Pablo Montoya"). Leadfoot is armed with general-purpose machine guns and a right shoulder multi-barrel machine gun. In _Age of Extinction_, he appears in drone video footage, being attacked and killed by Cemetery Wind agents or Lockdown. Cade, who hacks a Cemetery Wind's spy drone, shows the footage to the Autobots, compelling Hound to salute his fallen friend.

#### Roadbuster

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=26 "Edit section: Roadbuster")]

**Roadbuster** (voiced by Ron Bottitta) is the second-in-command of the Wreckers who transforms into an armored version of the No. 88 [Hendrick Motorsports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hendrick_Motorsports "Hendrick Motorsports")[AMP Energy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AMP_Energy "AMP Energy")/[National Guard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Guard_of_the_United_States "National Guard of the United States") driven by [Dale Earnhardt Jr.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dale_Earnhardt_Jr. "Dale Earnhardt Jr.") and speaks with a Scottish accent. Roadbuster is armed with light machine guns, a left shoulder multi-barrel machine gun, and shoulder rocket launchers. Roadbuster's fate after the events of _Age of Extinction_ is unknown.

#### Topspin

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=27 "Edit section: Topspin")]

**Topspin** (voiced by [Steven Barr](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steven_Barr "Steven Barr")) is one of the three Wreckers who transforms into an armored version of the No. 48 [Hendrick Motorsports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hendrick_Motorsports "Hendrick Motorsports")[Lowe's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lowe's "Lowe's")/[Kobalt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kobalt_(tools) "Kobalt (tools)") driven by [Jimmie Johnson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmie_Johnson "Jimmie Johnson"), and appears to have claws on his hands. Topspin is armed with heavy machine guns. In _The Last Knight_, he is seen in Cuba under the protection of Seymour Simmons and credited as "Volleybot".

## Maximals

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=29 "Edit section: Maximals")]

The **Maximals** are a faction of Transformers that debut in _Rise of the Beasts_ and sport techno-organic modes themed on [Earth animals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Animal "Animal"). They came from an unknown jungle-covered planet before it was devoured by Unicron.

### Optimus Primal

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=30 "Edit section: Optimus Primal")]

**Optimus Primal** (voiced by [Ron Perlman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ron_Perlman "Ron Perlman")) is the leader of the Maximals who transforms into an [eastern lowland gorilla](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_lowland_gorilla "Eastern lowland gorilla"). In robot mode, he wields two [kukris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kukri "Kukri") which can fuse into a double-bladed [sword](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sword "Sword").

### Cheetor

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=31 "Edit section: Cheetor")]

**[Cheetor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Beast_Wars_characters#Cheetor "List of Beast Wars characters")** (voiced by [Tongayi Chirisa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tongayi_Chirisa "Tongayi Chirisa")) is a Maximal scout who transforms into a [Southeast African cheetah](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Southeast_African_cheetah "Southeast African cheetah"). In his robot mode, he wields a [spear](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spear "Spear") which can split to two.

### Rhinox

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=32 "Edit section: Rhinox")]

**Rhinox** is a Maximal commando who transforms into a [south-central black rhinoceros](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South-central_black_rhinoceros "South-central black rhinoceros"). In his robot mode, he wields a [war hammer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/War_hammer "War hammer"). He is the only Maximal that doesn't speak.

### Airazor

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=33 "Edit section: Airazor")]

**Airazor** (voiced by [Michelle Yeoh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michelle_Yeoh "Michelle Yeoh")) is a Maximal warrior who transforms into a [peregrine falcon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peregrine_falcon "Peregrine falcon"). She guided the Autobots and their human allies to her fellow Maximals. She gets driven mad by Scourge with Unicron's Dark Energon before she tells Optimus Primal to [put her out of her misery](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euthanasia "Euthanasia"). Airazor was avenged when Scourge is killed.

### Apelinq

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=34 "Edit section: Apelinq")]

**Apelinq** (voiced by [David Sobolov](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Sobolov "David Sobolov")) is the former leader of the Maximals who transforms into a [mountain gorilla](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mountain_gorilla "Mountain gorilla"). He has a similar appearance to Optimus Primal, but with a different color scheme involving bronze and silver, owns bigger fangs on the higher [mandible](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mandible "Mandible"), a left shoulder that seems to be [asymmetrical](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asymmetrical "Asymmetrical") to the right (being slightly more bulked up), and wields retractable [axe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axe "Axe") blades on his [forearm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forearm "Forearm"); and his gorilla mode is [albino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albino "Albino") with orange optics instead of greens. After a brief scuffle with the Maximal, Apelinq is mortally wounded by Scourge before taking the latter's Maximal insignia as a trophy, but was too late to stop Optimus Primal and the rest of the Maximals from escaping the planet with the Transwarp Key before Unicron arrived and destroying their homeworld.

## Decepticons

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=35 "Edit section: Decepticons")]

The **Decepticons** are the main antagonists of the _Transformers_ film series and the enemies of the Autobots.

In five films, 48 Decepticons have appeared in the series.

### Megatron

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=36 "Edit section: Megatron")]

See also: [Megatron §Transformers Cinematic Universe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Megatron#Transformers_Cinematic_Universe "Megatron")

**[Megatron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Megatron#Transformers_Cinematic_Universe "Megatron")** (voiced by [Hugo Weaving](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugo_Weaving "Hugo Weaving") in the first three films, [Frank Welker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_Welker "Frank Welker") in _The Last Knight_ and the first two video games, [Fred Tatasciore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fred_Tatasciore "Fred Tatasciore") in the third video game and _Rise of the Dark Spark_) is Optimus Prime's [arch-enemy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Archenemy "Archenemy"), the malicious and tyrannical leader of the Decepticons and the main antagonist of the _Transformers_ film series (serving as the main antagonist of the [first](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers_(film) "Transformers (film)"), the second, the third and the fifth movies and a major antagonist in the [fourth movie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:_Age_of_Extinction "Transformers: Age of Extinction")).

Millennia before the films, Megatron crash-landed on Earth in [the Arctic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Arctic "The Arctic") in his quest to obtain the AllSpark. When he is defrosted, he keeps his original alien jet form out of vanity. During the final battle in Mission City, Megatron kills Jazz and duels Optimus Prime. After being weakened by human fighter jets, Megatron is killed by Sam, who pushes the AllSpark into his spark core. Later, Megatron's body is dumped into the deepest part of the Laurentian Abyss.

Megatron returns in _Revenge of the Fallen_. Megatron is resurrected by Scalpel and the Constructicons with a shard of the AllSpark. Upon being revived, Megatron gains a new alternative mode as a Cybertronian flying [tank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tank "Tank"). He kills Optimus Prime and both he and Soundwave hijack the Earth's telecommunications systems, allowing the Fallen to send a message that Sam be handed over to him. In Egypt, Megatron fights a resurrected Optimus, but is overpowered and badly damaged, losing the right side of his face and his right arm in the process. He watches as the Fallen is destroyed, and retreats with Starscream, swearing revenge.

In _Dark of the Moon_, with his right arm and his half face repaired, Megatron goes into hiding in [Tanzania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanzania "Tanzania"), and takes the form of a [Mack Titan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mack_Titan "Mack Titan") 10-wheeler [tanker truck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanker_truck "Tanker truck"). Megatron makes a secret deal with former Autobot leader Sentinel Prime to invade the Earth with an army using Space Bridge pillars and use humanity to rebuild their damaged planet together. Megatron is betrayed by Sentinel and has command of the Decepticons taken from him. During the battle in Chicago, Carly goads Megatron back into action, and he ambushes and cripples Sentinel. When Cybertron's trip through the Space Bridge fails, Megatron attempts to make a false truce with Optimus, but the latter sees through the ruse and attacks Megatron before he could shoot Optimus, tearing off Megatron's head with an Energon [axe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axe "Axe") before using his fusion shotgun to kill Sentinel.

In _Age of Extinction_, Megatron's head is seen at KSI where Brains discovers that Megatron's mind is still alive and in a deep stasis. Megatron silently manipulates Joshua Joyce and his creation of the artificial Transformers as part of his consciousness gets placed into Galvatron.

In _The Last Knight_, Galvatron reassumes his old identity of Megatron and searches for the talisman to find Quintessa's staff after regaining some of his Decepticons that were held captive by the TRF. In the final battle on Cybertron, he is defeated by Optimus when Optimus cuts off his right arm as he did in _Revenge of the Fallen_, and is kicked through a wall, sending him falling back to Earth.

### The Fallen

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=38 "Edit section: The Fallen")]

**[The Fallen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Fallen_(Transformers) "The Fallen (Transformers)")** (voiced by [Tony Todd](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tony_Todd "Tony Todd") in the film, [James Arnold Taylor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Arnold_Taylor "James Arnold Taylor") in the second video game), formerly **Megatronus Prime**, is the overarching antagonist of the _[Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers:\_Revenge\_of\_the\_Fallen "Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen")_ movie. A rogue Prime of the Dynasty of Primes, the Fallen is the founder and first of the Decepticons, and Megatron's master.

In 17,000 B.C., the Fallen and his brothers set out into the universe, seeking distant suns to harvest to create Energon by building Star Harvesters. In defiance of the Primes' rule, _Never destroy a planet with life_, the Fallen sets about building a Star Harvester on Earth, which would destroy both the planet and its sun. To do this, he steals the Matrix of Leadership – the only thing that can turn on such a machine – but his brothers stop him, retrieve the Matrix, and hide it from him. Years after his betrayal, he is found on the _Nemesis_, which had crash-landed on one of [Saturn's moons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moons_of_Saturn "Moons of Saturn"), in suspended animation. He can open Space Bridges at will and has [telekinesis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telekinesis "Telekinesis"), powers that are restricted to the original Dynasty of Primes. He wields a void scepter as a melee weapon.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-transformerslive1-16) In the film, the Fallen seeks to invade the Earth with an army of Decepticons and activate the Star Harvester for an alternative Energon source, as well as get revenge on humanity and the Autobots. He lands on Earth and uses the Earth's telecommunications grid (being hijacked by Megatron and Soundwave) to force the humans to hand over Sam Witwicky to guide the Decepticons to the Matrix of Leadership. In the final battle, the Fallen steals the Matrix from a revived Optimus Prime and starts up the Star Harvester. As the Star Harvester charges, Jetfire sacrifices himself to let Optimus use his components. After Ratchet and Jolt fuse Optimus with Jetfire's weaponry, Optimus Prime destroys the Star Harvester and the Fallen is killed by Optimus Prime who tears off his face (which reveals his skull) and crushes his spark.

### Starscream

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters&action=edit&section=39 "Edit section: Starscream")]

**[Starscream](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starscream#Transformers_Cinematic_Universe "Starscream")** (voiced by [Charlie Adler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Adler "Charlie Adler") in the films and the second video game, [Daniel Ross](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daniel_Ross_(actor) "Daniel Ross (actor)") in _Transformers: The Game_, [Steve Blum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Blum "Steve Blum") in the third video game, [Sam Riegel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sam_Riegel "Sam Riegel") in _Rise of the Dark Spark_) is Megatron's cowardly and self-serving apprentice and second-in-command who transforms into a [Lockheed Martin F-22 Raptor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lockheed_Martin_F-22_Raptor "Lockheed Martin F-22 Raptor") jet, and the secondary antagonist of the _Transformers_ franchise (serving as the secondary antagonist of the [first movie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformers_(film) "Transformers (film)"), and a major antagonist in the second and third movie).

In the first film, Starscream is seen lying in wait in an air base until he receives news from Frenzy about the AllSpark. He immediately orders the rest of the Decepticons to mobilize and head towards Hoover Dam, and is the first one to arrive. He begins by attacking the power lines of the Dam, speeding Megatron's thawing and encounters him later. Megatron is disappointed to learn that the AllSpark is with the humans and berates his lieutenant for his failure, while ordering him to retrieve it. He briefly assists the Decepticons' efforts in Mission City and would retreat when Megatron is killed. In _Revenge of the Fallen_, Starscream oversees Megatron's return but is berated for attempting to take command. He and the Fallen are worried about the Decepticon hatchlings, who are dying without Energon. Starscream would try to assist Megatron in his fight against Optimus Prime, but his arm is cut off. Megatron berates Starscream for failing to find Sam as he attempts to fix his arm. He is then seen attacking the Autobots and the humans as they head towards Egypt. He informs Megatron when Optimus' body is brought back and later takes part in the attack with the other Decepticon forces. After the Fallen's demise, a grievously wounded Megatron flees with Starscream, not before vowing vengeance. In _Dark of the Moon_, Starscream is killed by Sam Witwicky who blows his head apart with one of Que's boomsticks. In _The Last Knight_, his head is in Daytrader's possession, who claims he found it in Buffalo, New York. Later it is seen being held by Megatron reminiscing about him. Starscream in his G1 design appears in a cameo in _Bumblebee_ attacking the Autobots during their evacuation of Cybertron.

Long Haul's robot mode was designed by freelance artist Josh Nizzi as fan art of the original character, by the time _Revenge of the Fallen_ had just been greenlit.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-31) The fan art impressed Bay enough to hire him on to the film.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-32) He is killed during an air strike in the battle of Egypt. Although in the movie Long Haul's alt mode is a Caterpillar 773B, a relatively small truck, Nizzi had originally meant Long Haul to be a [Caterpillar 797](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caterpillar_797 "Caterpillar 797").[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Transformers_film_series_cast_and_characters#cite_note-33) In _Dark of the Moon_, Long Haul is reused in the battle of Chicago before it is destroyed by Optimus. He forms the right leg of Devastator. Long Haul's weapons are rockets that are placed on the top of both his hands.
